properties.description: Written before the code (commit ac6a9c6d4) and observed failing there. Core, crates/reflow2-core/tests/changelog.rs: the snapshot written at apply on the Snapshot type linked to the release, and none on a dry run; one whole and two deltas across three cuts, each reading back to exactly what the design held at its cut; a re-run of apply leaving a past snapshot byte for byte; a release whose manifest was frozen earlier getting none; a discontinued capability kept as discontinued with its status unmoved; each balance count (requirements, capabilities, decisions, checks now failing, failures that came back) with how it was counted; an end with no snapshot (a release, an epoch) named and never zero; added-and-dropped inside one window in neither column and the limit stated; [Unreleased] reading the last deployed release against the live design; and the status snapshot not read as the release's own history (mutation-checked). MCP, crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_changelog_balance_only_adds_to_the_reply.rs: both replies keep every key and kind they had and add one field each.
properties.findings: 2026-10-13 on branch feat/the-changelog-shows-a-balance. BEFORE the code (ac6a9c6d4): the core file did not compile (26 errors: no `balance` on ChangelogDraft, no `status_snapshot` on DerivedManifest, no `release_statuses` / `current_statuses`), and the MCP test compiled and FAILED with `status_snapshot` null. AFTER (b872fc173): cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test changelog 20 passed, 0 failed (the 19 written first, plus a guard that the status snapshot is not read as the release's own history; removing the filter in snapshots_of makes it fail). cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --test the_changelog_balance_only_adds_to_the_reply 1 passed. Whole in-memory core suite: 221 suites, 2,072 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast: 386 suites, 3,267 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored, exit 0. Clippy -D warnings clean for both configurations; smoke_mcp, empty_speaks, refusal_speaks, replies_are_bounded, a_reply_is_sent_once, toolsnap, skill_lint, tool_confusability and render_skills_and_tools --check pass on the debug binary.
properties.name: The cut keeps a status snapshot, and the changelog's balance counts from it without zeros it did not see
